overall.summary: GFF has materially degraded its disclosure quality in the current 10-Q filing, particularly around supply chain risks, tariff/geopolitical exposure, and China-sourcing risks. This is especially concerning because the same filing reports a $243.6M goodwill/intangible impairment at Hunter Fan explicitly driven by tariff impacts and weak demand—meaning the risks being de-emphasized are actively materializing. The company has replaced multi-paragraph, data-rich risk discussions with single-sentence cross-references to prior filings, creating a pattern consistent with deliberate obfuscation during a period of heightened operational stress.
